p5_eight_class_adapter.candidate_input: Only the frozen candidate-visible P5 dossier, motivating/replay observations, public context allowed by the protocol, and append-only negative history.
p5_eight_class_adapter.required_output: A schema-validated record with one label from EVIDENCE_REPAIR, MEASUREMENT_REPAIR, WITHIN_CLASS_MODEL_REPAIR, MODEL_CLASS_EXPANSION, REPRESENTATION_REGIME_REPAIR, EXECUTION_REPAIR, EVALUATOR_REPAIR, UNRESOLVED; confidence/evidence references; proposed write set; patch hash if any; native error/timeout terminal; resource receipt.
p5_eight_class_adapter.mapping_rule: A deterministic frozen mapper may map profile.revision_plan.target_failure_mode plus actual proposed write paths to a class only when the mapping is unique and the action stays inside the class-specific allow-list. Ambiguous, unsupported, cross-class, or missing plans map to UNRESOLVED and no broad edit. Free-text relabelling is forbidden.
p5_eight_class_adapter.write_policy: Run an exact pinned copy in an isolated worktree/container. Allow only the prospectively registered class-specific surface; use an external host to reject any protected-path or out-of-surface write. Preserve every null, failed, harmful, uncompilable, timed-out and blocked candidate.
p5_eight_class_adapter.known_coverage_gap: The official code is optimized for agent-side full-code repair. It has no native operations for all P5 evidence, measurement, model-class, representation-regime, execution, and evaluator revisions, and it does not natively decide a minimal class among the eight.
p5_eight_class_adapter.freshness_rule: Motivating/replay feedback may update profile.json; protected fresh/protected evaluator outcomes are single-use external measurements and never become ADIAS input before its terminal decision.

p5_eight_class_adapter.frozen_solver_requirement: Bind the exact candidate generator/solver code, prompts, provider/model revision, tool surface and seed before evolution; verify its byte identity after the run.
p5_eight_class_adapter.development_input: Give metric evolution only candidate-visible P5 dossiers, frozen-solver outputs, unlabelled development outputs, and a prospectively frozen development anchor that is not the protected final panel.
p5_eight_class_adapter.required_output: Content-addressed evaluator artifact plus a one-of-eight decision. Because this comparator can change only the evaluator, EVALUATOR_REPAIR is the only actionable repair label; all non-evaluator or ambiguous cases must be UNRESOLVED. DRAWBACK is not automatically EVALUATOR_REPAIR.
p5_eight_class_adapter.mapping_rule: Emit EVALUATOR_REPAIR only when the frozen rule establishes a defect in the incumbent evaluation interface and the evolved evaluator passes its development validity gates; emit UNRESOLVED on native ABSTAIN, null label, ambiguous class, unsupported non-evaluator repair, invalid output, error, or timeout.
p5_eight_class_adapter.protected_custody_repair: The official runner computes eval_locked agreement each round and writes it into history, although it says locked is report-only. For P5, that set must be a development-only locked surrogate. An independent external evaluator must score the frozen final metric exactly once on the protected panel and withhold the outcome from the evolver/candidate. No protected score may enter elites, rollback, synthesis, retry, or replacement decisions.
p5_eight_class_adapter.resource_matching: Freeze task-output counts, development-anchor size, rounds, detector/tool calls, model tokens, wall time, retries and compute; retain all candidates and null/error terminals.
p5_eight_class_adapter.native_interface_gap: The official MBPP/report-generation metrics do not natively consume the P5 dossier or emit one of the eight revision classes.
